properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.enabled
properties.description: Enable the outbox relay auto-configuration and schedulers.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of pending events claimed per poll.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.lock-timeout
properties.description: Age after which PROCESSING locks are considered abandoned.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.default-max-attempts
properties.description: Default max publication attempts for new events.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.instance-id
properties.description: Worker identity stored in locked_by. Defaults to hostname plus process id.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.recovery-interval
properties.description: Delay between runs of the abandoned-lock recovery job.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.maintenance-batch-size
properties.description: Rows touched per statement by the recovery and cleanup jobs. Both drain in batches of this size so a large backlog cannot become one long-running statement.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.publish-timeout
properties.description: Deadline for a whole claimed batch to be acknowledged by the broker. Also bounds how long a poll holds its claims, so keep it below lock-timeout to stop the recovery job from reclaiming rows that are still in flight.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.backlog-metrics-interval
properties.description: How often the outbox.pending.count and outbox.oldest.pending.age gauges are refreshed. The gauges read cached values, so this fixes the database cost regardless of how many collectors scrape the application.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: How long shutdown waits for the job run in progress to finish before giving up. Cutting a relay run short leaves its claims in PROCESSING until lock-timeout elapses.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.retry.initial-delay
properties.description: Base delay for the first retry.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.retry.maximum-delay
properties.description: Upper bound for the exponential backoff delay.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Factor applied to the delay on each successive attempt.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.retry.jitter
properties.description: Random fraction added to or subtracted from the computed delay, between 0.0 and 1.0.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.cleanup.interval
properties.description: Delay between runs of the published-event cleanup job.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Enable cleanup of published outbox events.

properties.name: spring.outbox.relay.cleanup.retention
properties.description: Retention period for published events before deletion.
